title: The Lusiad; Or, The Discovery of India, an Epic Poem

author: Luís de Camões
description: "The Lusiad; Or, The Discovery of India, an Epic Poem" by Luís de Camões is a Portuguese epic poem first published in 1572.
longDescription: Written in ten cantos with over a thousand stanzas, this national masterpiece celebrates Vasco da Gama's voyage to India.

authorInfo.bio: Luís de Camões (–1580) wrote The Lusiad; Or, The Discovery of India, an Epic Poem. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
